description: UK Self Assessment penalties for a tax year (online deadline 31 January after the year ends): late filing £100, then £10 a day after 3 months for up to 90 days, then the greater of 5% of the tax or £300 at 6 and again at 12 months; late payment 5% of unpaid tax at 30 days, 6 months and 12 months; plus late payment interest. MTD for Income Tax penalties are different and not calculated. United Kingdom, as of 2026-11-21 (gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk). Income Tax bands are for England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scottish bands are not calculated. General information and estimates only; not personal tax advice, no agent services and no filing with HMRC.
